stance_summary: US front-end yields, the Sep 16 hike and August CPI tightening bias are still aligned. Short US 2Y duration is the cleanest continuation; fading 99th-percentile yields or the 1-day Canada dip is premature. USDCAD is the spot alternative but is a weaker, 1-month-only trend versus an unambiguous 1d/5d/1m/3m US 2Y backup. Flat $100m still pays 5% ACT/365, so this empty book must own the live trend.

expression_comparison.rates_candidate: Short US_2Y outright duration (pay fixed / higher 2Y yield) at executable_marks 4.76. Alternative rates RV: short CA-US_2Y at -140bp (spread already 3.8th percentile 1y and still more negative on 5d/1m) is the same US-outperformance trend but is as-of mismatched (CA 17 Sep vs US 18 Sep) and mixes in Canada-specific labor softness.
expression_comparison.spot_candidate: Long USDCAD at executable_marks 1.4010471204188482, supported by a 140bp US-CA 2Y differential and a +1.74% 1m / +1.10% 5d USD-CAD trend.
expression_comparison.rationale: Rates is cleaner and is the default when both expressions are usable. US 2Y is higher on every frozen horizon (+9bp 1d, +13bp 5d, +57bp 1m, +57bp 3m; 99.8th percentile 1y; z_1y 2.84) and sits in the tenor that owns the delivered hike plus residual tightening bias. USDCAD's 3m return is still -1.25% with only a 1y z of 0.80, so the spot trend is younger and less aligned than the yield trend. The discrepancy is that discretionary fade of statistically extreme yields after a >90% priced hike; that lives in duration, not in a mixed USD-CAD spot tape.

trade.structure: outright short US 2Y duration (pay fixed); paper mark is the 2Y yield
trade.thesis: Causal test: after a delivered 25bp hike, do US front-end yields keep rising because inflation and policy remain aligned, or does 99th-percentile yield automatically mean-revert? Verified fact: Fed funds moved 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 16 Sep; futures had >90% hike odds into that meeting; August CPI is retained as keeping the tightening bias intact; US 2Y is 4.76 as of 18 Sep, up 9bp 1d / 13bp 5d / 57bp 1m / 57bp 3m, 99.8th percentile 1y. Decomposition: 2Y +57bp 1m versus 10Y +36bp and 2s10s at 25bp (0.2nd percentile 1y, -21bp 1m) is a front-end-led flattening, not a long-end term-premium story. Inference: the post-hike +9bp 2Y backup shows the market is not treating 16 Sep as terminal; price, revisions and policy are still aligned, so the trend should persist longer than a fade of the z-score. Unknown: CME positioning; official NZ yields; whether the next inflation/labor print confirms or kills extra hike risk. Housing pain in Australia is the tightening channel working, not a reversal signal for this US-2Y expression. Mean-reversion without an independent reversal catalyst is rejected.
trade.mispricing: The live gap is not 'yields are high so buy duration.' It is the assumption that a fully priced hike plus 1y z of 2.84 is sufficient to fade a still-rising 2Y. Market-implied into 16 Sep required the 25bp hike; it did not require the subsequent 2Y backup or a still-open tightening bias. Fading that tape is the premature reversal. USDCAD does not own the same gap: 3m USDCAD is down even as US 2Y is up on every horizon.
why_now: US 2Y is higher on every frozen horizon: +9bp 1d, +13bp 5d, +57bp 1m, +57bp 3m, 99.8th percentile 1y, z_1y 2.84 (market_state as of 2026-09-18).
The 16 Sep FOMC hike to 3.75-4.00% has already printed and was >90% priced, yet 2Y still sold off 9bp by 18 Sep — the continuation, not the decision, is the live trend.
August CPI is retained as keeping the Fed tightening bias intact; ISM Services 55.4 and August retail +1.2% m/m do not give the fade a growth-collapse catalyst.
This seat's empty $100m book still pays 5% ACT/365 while flat; sitting out after a persistent, policy-aligned yield trend donates the vig with no offsetting P&L.

trade.horizon: 4-8 weeks, through the next US inflation prints and FOMC cycle
trade.invalidation: Invalidate if the US 2Y 1-month uptrend (+57bp to 4.76 as of 2026-09-18) reverses, or if subsequent US inflation/labor evidence removes the Fed tightening bias documented by August CPI and the 16 Sep 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00%. A 1-day dip without that policy/data break is not invalidation.
catalysts: Follow-through in US front-end yields after the delivered 16 Sep hike and the retained August CPI tightening-bias narrative
US 2s10s at 25bp / 0.2nd percentile 1y already records front-end-led flattening that persists if extra hike risk stays live
Canada headline CPI still 3.0% with BoC minutes flagging energy pass-through; that supports a wider CA-US yield gap as a secondary confirmation, not the owner of this trade
principal_risks: Statistical extension: US 2Y z_1y 2.84 and 99.8th percentile 1y can pause or retrace without a fundamental reversal; this seat still refuses to fade on z-score alone.
Consumer/confidence softness (Michigan preliminary September 47.8, US consumer score 48.5) and Q2 GDP +1.5% SAAR versus +2.1% Q1 could re-anchor a one-and-done narrative.
The hike itself was >90% priced; additional backup requires the bias to stay open, which the packet does not guarantee.
Known gaps: CME positioning unavailable; official NZ yields unavailable; market-state NZ_rates stale/unavailable; no executable broker prices beyond frozen marks.
Global duration bid: CA 2Y -8bp and CA 10Y -9bp on 17 Sep show a 1-day Canada rally that could spill into US 2s if it becomes a reversal rather than noise.

remit: persistent price, rates and macro trends; reject premature fades

conflict_synopsis.core_view: US 2Y, the delivered hike and August CPI tightening bias remain aligned, so continue to pay the front end rather than fade 99th-percentile yields.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Post-hike US front-end follow-through while August CPI keeps the tightening bias intact.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: US 2Y 1-month uptrend reverses or US inflation/labor evidence removes the Fed tightening bias.

paper_capital.funding_hurdle_rationale: This funded seat pays 5% ACT/365 on the full $100m every day whether risk is on or not; the book is an empty $100m seed with last_action HOLD and no overnight review. A persistent US 2Y uptrend of +57bp over both 1m and 3m, still printing +9bp after a delivered hike, is the highest-velocity marked expression in the packet. Staying flat donates the vig with zero offsetting P&L. $75m short US_2Y at the frozen 4.76 mark is large enough for continued front-end backup to matter versus the clock, and below the $100m cap because z_1y 2.84 and consumer softness are real pause risks, not fade signals. Market coupon carry on a short 2Y opposes the trade; the paper funding clock still requires owning the continuation rather than waiting for a prettier entry that the packet does not provide.
